newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy gas oil, jet for Mar 9-10.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy gas oil, jet for Mar 9-10.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy gas oil and aviation jet fuel for March 9-10 delivery, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
The tender seeks 220,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil and 55,000 barrels of jet fuel.
It closes on February 25 and offers will be valid for two days.

In its last tender, Sri Lanka bought 220,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel from French oil firm Total at a premium of 61 cents per barrel to Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f Colombo.

It also bought 65,000 barrels each of 1.0-percent sulphur and 0.5-percent sulphur gas oil and 15,000 barrels of illuminating kerosene at $2.20 per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f Trincomalee.
Both combination cargoes are for March 1-2 deliveries.
